यूपाक्ष १

YŪPĀKṢA I . A military commander of rāvaṇa. In the battle between śrī rāma and rāvaṇa, he was killed by hanūmān. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, sundara Kāṇḍa, 46: 32).

यूपाक्ष २

YŪPĀKṢA II . A rākṣasa. In the battle between Śrī rāma and rāvaṇa, this rākṣasa was killed by the monkey mainda. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, yuddha Kāṇḍa 76: 34).
